description: The chart illustrates task counts by language family, with each family showing how many tasks are labeled as better for mBERT, better for XLM-R, or the same. The horizontal axis contains the language-family categories (IE-Baltic, IE-Germanic, IE-Indic, IE-Romance, IE-Slavic, IE-other, Isolate, Semitic, Uralic) in that left-to-right order, and the vertical axis is labeled “task count” on a linear scale ranging from 0 to 40 with tick marks at 0, 10, 20, 30, and 40. For each category there are three adjacent bars corresponding to the legend titled “better”: a light blue bar for mBERT, a darker blue bar for XLM-R, and a light green bar for same; for IE-Baltic the bars are approximately mBERT 0, XLM-R 10, same 7; for IE-Germanic about mBERT 4, XLM-R 18, same 22; for IE-Indic about mBERT 1, XLM-R 5, same 4; for IE-Romance about mBERT 4, XLM-R 13, same 30; for IE-Slavic about mBERT 12, XLM-R 39, same 28; for IE-other about mBERT 1, XLM-R 6, same 8; for Isolate about mBERT 1, XLM-R 5, same 1; for Semitic about mBERT 0, XLM-R 7, same 1; and for Uralic about mBERT 1, XLM-R 14, same 5. The bars are grouped by category (not stacked), there is no visual sorting by bar height beyond the fixed category order, and no individual bars appear specially emphasized beyond the color coding and the legend.
